ground_truth.main_content_markdown:
Some of my best blogging friends and I are sharing our favorite **easy DIY wood projects** that we made using power tools. While mine is not a big piece of furniture or a complicated build, it is definitely one of my favorite projects.

## 10 Easy DIY Wood Projects

I made this wooden quilt block wall art back in April and wrote all about how to make it [here](https://createandbabble.com/wooden-quilt-block-wall-art/).

As soon as I hung it up on my kitchen wall I thought how cool it would be to build more of these blocks with different but coordinating papers and have a wooden quilt on the wall! I haven’t made any more yet but maybe I can do that over the winter months.

I can’t wait to see what my friends’ favorite projects are:

[Industrial Pipe Bookshelf](https://www.virginiasweetpea.com/diy-industrial-pipe-bookshelf/)

[Reclaimed Wood Arrows](https://designeddecor.com/repurposed-pallet-wood-arrows/)

[DIY Lanterns](https://www.justthewoods.com/scroll-saw-diy-lantern/)

[Rustic Fireplace Mantel](https://www.domestically-speaking.com/rustic-fireplace-mantel/)

[Cornhole Boards](https://www.thekimsixfix.com/2015/08/build-diy-cornhole-boards-from-cabinet.html)

[2 x 4 Bench](https://www.myrepurposedlife.com/simple-bench-made-from-2x4s/)

[DIY Murphy Bed](https://www.thediyvillage.com/2015/12/diy-murphy-bed-making-room-for-guests.html)

[Cordless Drill Organizer](https://www.hertoolbelt.com/cordless-drill-storage-charging-station/)

[Repurposed Frame Wall Shelf](https://h2obungalow.com/diy-repurposed-picture-frame-wall-shelves/)

What would you like to make? I hope these projects have inspired you to pick up a power tool and make something for your home.

Here is [**Where I Party**](https://createandbabble.com/where-i-party/)!
